name: Laparoscopic Appendectomy
description: Minimally invasive surgical procedure to remove the inflamed appendix through small abdominal incisions.

name: Cataract Surgery (Phacoemulsification with Foldable IOL)
description: Modern cataract extraction using ultrasonic phacoemulsification with foldable intraocular lens implantation.

name: Total Knee Replacement (Unilateral)
description: Complete replacement of the damaged knee joint surfaces with biocompatible prosthetic components.

name: Total Hip Replacement
description: Reconstruction of the hip joint replacing femoral head and acetabular socket with artificial implants.

name: Coronary Angioplasty (PTCA with Drug Eluting Stent)
description: Percutaneous coronary intervention to widen blocked coronary arteries with drug-eluting stent deployment.

name: Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy (Gallbladder Removal)
description: Keyhole removal of the gallbladder for cholelithiasis (gallstones) or chronic cholecystitis.

name: Inguinal Hernia Repair (Laparoscopic Mesh Plasty)
description: Tension-free laparoscopic mesh placement to reinforce weakened abdominal wall in the groin.

name: Caesarean Section Delivery (LSCS)
description: Lower segment caesarean section surgical birth including neonatal initial observation and obstetric care.

name: Kidney Stone Procedure (PCNL / RIRS Laser Lithotripsy)
description: Endoscopic laser breakdown and clearance of renal and ureteric calculi.

name: Coblation Tonsillectomy
description: Controlled ablation removal of palatine tonsils for recurrent tonsillitis or sleep-disordered breathing.
